card.name: Small words in titles and references
card.fires_on: Small linking words like 'of', 'the' or 'If', and stray digits or symbols, inside book titles, citations, URLs and web page footers. No single word triggers it.

modes.label: 'of'/'the' in titles
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'the' inside a book title or after 'description of' or 'distribution of' in footer text.
modes.example: Ward's Book<< of>> Days. Pages of interesting anniversaries

modes.label: Digits and symbols in codes
modes.description: A digit, space or equals sign inside a part number, URL or puzzle clue.
